remarks: Welcome to this spacious and bright 2-bedroom apartment in a prime Norwalk location! This stunning, tastefully remodeled unit features an updated kitchen with stainless steel appliances, quartz countertops, and luxury vinyl flooring throughout. Enjoy the sophisticated lifestyle in a well-managed complex with easy access to the vibrant amenities of this historic town.
